$10 per date; $10 per day for overnights (1-2 nights). No appointment: visit the Adoption Center (5850 Brannen Rd S) after 11am. Dates return by 4pm; overnights return by 4pm weekends / 4:30pm weekdays. No dog parks, no contact with other animals, no long-distance travel. Questions: 863-577-4615.
